strings.zh: 正好我这里有重复的贴纸,{NEWLINE}大哥哥如果也有贴纸盒的话,{CLEAR}我就能分给你一些了。
strings.en: I happen to have some extra{NEWLINE}Seals. If you had a Seal Case too, big{CLEAR}brother, I could share some with you.

strings.zh: 大哥哥想要贴纸吗？{NEWLINE}正好我这里有重复的贴纸,{CLEAR}也送给你一些吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Do you want some Seals,{NEWLINE}big brother? I happen to have{CLEAR}extras, so I’ll give you some too!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 啥ー啊！{NEWLINE}想给你贴纸{CLEAR}你却没有贴纸盒……{SCROLL}但是不用担心,{SCROLL}贴纸盒的话{NEWLINE}姐姐会给你！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Shocking!{NEWLINE}I really want to give you some{CLEAR}Seals, but you don’t have a{CLEAR}Seal Case...{SCROLL}But don’t you worry.{NEWLINE}My sister can give you a Seal Case!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 哎呀！{NEWLINE}你的贴纸太多了！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Oh dear! You have too many Seals!{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0398/3 | RV042: meaning: 哎呀 is dismay, not “Ha!”; zh says too many Seals

strings.zh: 我和家人在这里经营哞哞农场,{NEWLINE}全地区大部分的哞哞牛奶{CLEAR}都是由我们农场供应的。{CLEAR}是不是很了不起呀？
strings.en: My family and I run MooMoo Farm{NEWLINE}here. Most of the Moomoo Milk in the{CLEAR}whole region comes from our farm.{SCROLL}Pretty impressive, huh?

strings.zh: 哞哞牛奶的销售工作{NEWLINE}由我们的大女儿负责。{CLEAR}她一般都会在农场入口{CLEAR}向路过的游客推销牛奶。{CLEAR}如果你想买牛奶的话去找她就好了。
strings.en: Our eldest daughter handles{NEWLINE}Moomoo Milk sales. She’s{CLEAR}usually at the farm entrance,{CLEAR}selling milk to passing tourists.{SCROLL}If you’d like to buy some{NEWLINE}milk, just go see her.

strings.zh: 我们农场的大奶罐{NEWLINE}最近好像生病了,{CLEAR}有的大奶罐非常躁动无法入睡,{CLEAR}有的大奶罐则一睡不起,{CLEAR}怎么叫都叫不醒。{SCROLL}我请了好多饲育家来都找不到病因。{NEWLINE}唉,再这样下去农场就要倒闭了。
strings.en: The Miltank on our farm seem{NEWLINE}to have gotten sick lately.{SCROLL}Some are so restless they can’t sleep,{NEWLINE}and others fall asleep and won’t{CLEAR}wake up no matter how you call them.{SCROLL}I’ve called in lots of Pokémon{NEWLINE}Breeders, but none of them can{CLEAR}find the cause. Sigh... At this{CLEAR}rate, the farm will go under.

strings.zh: 我在收集贴纸哦,{NEWLINE}把各种各样的贴纸贴在精灵球上,{CLEAR}就能制作个性化精灵球。
strings.en: I collect Seals! If you stick all{NEWLINE}kinds of Seals on Poké Balls, you can{CLEAR}make your own custom Poké Balls.

strings.zh: 我们给大奶罐提供的{NEWLINE}饮食和休息环境应该都没问题啊,{CLEAR}怎么会生病呢……
strings.en: The food and resting area we{NEWLINE}give the Miltank should be fine...{CLEAR}How could they get sick...?

strings.zh: 大奶罐『Miii——tan！{SCROLL}大奶罐无精打采。
strings.en: Miltank: Miii-tan!{SCROLL}Miltank looks listless.

strings.zh: 大奶罐睡得很香。
strings.en: Miltank is sleeping soundly.

strings.zh: 大奶罐『Miiii——tan！
strings.en: Miltank: Miiii-tan!

strings.zh: 大奶罐最近生病了,{NEWLINE}爸爸和妈妈都很担心。{CLEAR}可是我却帮不上什么忙,呜……
strings.en: Our Miltank got sick, and Mom and{NEWLINE}Dad are really worried. But I can’t{CLEAR}do anything to help... *sniff*...

strings.zh: 只要在电脑的菜单里选择「球贴」,{NEWLINE}就能随心地选择贴纸{CLEAR}贴到喜欢的球上了。
strings.en: Just choose BALL CAPSULES from the{NEWLINE}PC menu, and you can stick any Seals{CLEAR}you like on your favorite Balls.

strings.zh: 空气中弥漫着奇异的能量。{SCROLL}能量与身上的新月之羽发生了反应！
strings.en: A strange energy fills the air.{SCROLL}The energy reacted to the{NEWLINE}Lunar Wing you’re carrying!

strings.zh: 多亏有你帮忙,{NEWLINE}农场里的大奶罐都恢复健康了。{CLEAR}我们这儿地处偏远也没啥能感谢你的,{CLEAR}这一打哞哞牛奶就请你收下吧。
strings.en: Thanks to your help, all the Miltank{NEWLINE}on the farm are healthy again.{SCROLL}We’re way out in the country, so we{NEWLINE}don’t have much to thank you with.{CLEAR}Please accept this dozen Moomoo Milk.

strings.zh: 正好我这里有重复的贴纸,{NEWLINE}大姐姐如果也有贴纸盒的话,{CLEAR}我就能分给你一些了。
strings.en: I happen to have some extra Seals.{NEWLINE}If you had a Seal Case too, big{CLEAR}sister, I could share some with you.

strings.zh: 大姐姐想要贴纸吗？{NEWLINE}正好我这里有重复的贴纸,{CLEAR}也送给你一些吧！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Do you want some Seals, big{NEWLINE}sister? I happen to have extras,{CLEAR}so I’ll give you some too!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 你好像是很厉害的训练家嘛,{NEWLINE}如果你有时间的话,{CLEAR}拜托帮我们查一下{CLEAR}大奶罐生病的原因好吗？
strings.en: You look like a really strong Trainer.{NEWLINE}If you have time, could you please help{CLEAR}us find out why our Miltank are sick?

strings.zh: 太好了,真的是非常感谢。{NEWLINE}大奶罐就在西边的房间里,{CLEAR}你从那边开始调查就好。
strings.en: That’s great, thank you so much.{NEWLINE}The Miltank are in the room to the{CLEAR}west. You can start looking there.
strings.notes: #24/#25 are two replies with the same content (different politeness in zh).

strings.zh: 非常感谢你愿意帮忙。{NEWLINE}大奶罐就在西边的房间里,{CLEAR}你从那边开始调查就好。
strings.en: Thank you so much for helping.{NEWLINE}The Miltank are in the room to the{CLEAR}west. You can start looking there.

strings.zh: 似乎有一种神秘的力量{NEWLINE}正弥漫在空气中。
strings.en: A mysterious power{NEWLINE}seems to fill the air.

strings.zh: 一树『是你！？{NEWLINE}梨花『联盟冠军{VAR:0103:0}！？
strings.en: Will: You?!{NEWLINE}Karen: League Champion {VAR:0103:0}?!

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好啊,原来大奶罐生病{NEWLINE}是你们火箭队搞的鬼。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Well, well. So Team Rocket{NEWLINE}is behind the Miltank getting sick.

strings.zh: 一树『蠢货,你也太瞧不起我们火箭队了。
strings.en: Will: Idiot. Don’t sell{NEWLINE}Team Rocket so short.

strings.zh: 梨花『区区几只破奶牛而已,{NEWLINE}谁会打它们的主意。
strings.en: Karen: A few crummy dairy{NEWLINE}cows? Who’d bother with them?

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『那你们来这里干什么？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Then what are you doing here?

strings.zh: 一树『虽然你诚心诚意地发问了,{NEWLINE}但我们可没义务告诉你。
strings.en: Will: Prepare for trouble? Sorry, we’re{NEWLINE}under no obligation to tell you a thing.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『按你们火箭队的惯例,{NEWLINE}不应该是大发慈悲地告诉我吗？
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: By Team Rocket custom, aren’t{NEWLINE}you supposed to ‘make it double’ and{CLEAR}tell me?

strings.zh: 梨花『我们可不是那些低级队员,{NEWLINE}要不要大发慈悲全看心情。
strings.en: Karen: We’re not some low-level grunts.{NEWLINE}Whether we make it double depends on{CLEAR}our mood.

strings.zh: 梨花『喂,一树,{NEWLINE}进入「那个世界」的空间裂缝怎么样了！
strings.en: Karen: Hey, Will, how’s the rift{NEWLINE}into ‘that world’ coming along?

strings.zh: 一树『空气中的能量浓度已经足够,{NEWLINE}我现在就……
strings.en: Will: The energy in the air is{NEWLINE}dense enough. I’ll do it now...

strings.zh: 一树『把咱们两个……
strings.en: Will: The two of us...

strings.zh: 一树『传送进去……
strings.en: Will: ...will be sent through...

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『消失了！？{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}『「那个世界」？传送？{NEWLINE}跟娜姿的超能力有些像啊……
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: They vanished?!{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}: ‘That world’? Sent{NEWLINE}through? That sounds a bit like{CLEAR}Sabrina’s psychic powers...
{VAR:0103:0}: Wait, me too...?!
strings.notes: RV042: grammar: 怎么我也……！？: the player is being pulled in too; old line was ungrammatical

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『那看来我只能用实力{NEWLINE}问出答案了。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Looks like I’ll just have to{NEWLINE}get the answers out of you by force.
{VAR:0103:0}: Where... is this?
